title: Hattie the Mouse and the Sparkly Bissolam
summary: Hattie the Mouse embarks on a creative journey to make a magnificent piece of sparkly art, complete with jingle bells and balloons, for her friends Victor, Mr. Slinger, and Lily. As she prepares for the Bissolam—a joyful day of dancing and music—Hattie visits her baby sister, Oscar Mouse, and several other tiny friends at the hospital's baby lounge. When Oscar finally returns home, she finds herself missing the crackers and colors of the lounge. Hattie comforts her with songs and the promise of home-made drawings, eventually singing her baby sister into a peaceful sleep.
